subject: Key usage telemetry & rotation witness inquiry
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@beaconfin.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@beaconfin.com
Date: Mon, 25 Sep 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Request: key usage telemetry + rotation witness for SOC2 sampling

Hi Jonas,

As part of our SOC 2 readiness work (control CC6 / cryptographic key management) we need to collect a short sample of operational telemetry and rotation evidence for keys used by your hosted inference service for the BH (Beacon) tenant. Specifically Beacon is looking for:

- a 30-day sample of KMS operation logs (wrap/unwrap, generate, delete, import) with timestamps, key IDs, and caller/service principal; CSV OK
- a summary of rotation windows for tenant keys (dates + who initiated rotation + rotation method: in-place/new-key/dual-wrap) for Q3 2028
- HSM attestation or certificate for the HSM instances that handled wrap/unwrap in the sample period
- an explanation of how transient/ephemeral keys used by caching are excluded from persistent rotation metrics

We know some artifacts may be redacted; please indicate what fields are redacted and why. Goal: provide an auditable sample for our SOC auditor next week. Can you confirm what you can provide and a target delivery date?

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Senior Information Security Manager
Beacon Financial

--

From: jonas.weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a curated telemetry sample and HSM attestation. High level plan:

1) Deliver a 30-day CSV export with operation type, key_id (redacted to last 8 chars), timestamp (UTC), service_principal, and region. We will redact tenant-identifying tokens but preserve caller principal and operation types for auditor traceability.
2) Provide a rotation window summary spreadsheet (dates, actor, method) for Q3.
3) Attach HSM attestation and the signing chain for the HSM cluster that handled wrap/unwrap ops.

Irene — can you pull the CSV export and HSM attestation? Marissa — please prepare the rotation spreadsheet and a short narrative that explains ephemeral-caching exclusion (one paragraph).

Olivia — can you confirm Beacon's auditor cutoff (preferred delivery by EOD Thu 2028-09-28) or do you need more time? If you need signed statements from our Security/Legal we can include that but it takes an extra day.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Team — attaching the artifacts we agreed on. Notes inline.

Attachments:
- kms-usage-sample-sept2028.csv (CSV, 30-day slice, operations: GENERATE, WRAP, UNWRAP, IMPORT, ROTATE)
- rotation-window-summary-2028Q3.xlsx (sheet includes actor, method, effective_time_utc)
- hsm-attestation-sept2028.pdf (vendor-signed attestation; redactions: serial numbers for hardware endpoints where required by policy)

I redacted the first 24 characters of key_id and left the last 8 so Beacon's auditor can map activity without exposing full material identifiers. Caller principals include internal-service@redwood and customer-tenant-proxy@redwood (these are safe to share). The CSV includes an additional column called 'redaction_reason' when we removed an element.

Marissa — the short narrative is in sheet "notes" in the rotation spreadsheet. In brief: ephemeral keys used by continuous-batching cache are created with TTL < 2 minutes and never persisted to customer KMS backends; they are not listed in rotation artifacts because rotation applies to persistent tenant key objects only.

Delivery ETA: I am uploading these to the shared Drive link (see below). If Beacon needs PGP-signed copies or a notarized attestation, flag and we'll route through Legal.

Drive: https://redwood.share/drive/keyops/kms-telemetry-2028Q3

-Irene
Irene Choi

If you can provide those by EOD Fri 2028-10-05 we can wrap the SOC sampling. If Legal needs to sign the attestation, tell us and we'll accommodate the delay.
